ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Koadic Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects command line parameters used by Koadic hack tool

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/q.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*chcp.*")))
